Misconfigurations.Title: CPU not limited
Misconfigurations.Description: Enforcing CPU limits prevents DoS via resource exhaustion.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs as root user
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the running image to run as a non-root user to ensure least privileges.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'init-permissions' of StatefulSet 'redis' should set 'securityContext.runAsNonRoot' to true

Misconfigurations.Title: CPU requests not specified
Misconfigurations.Description: When containers have resource requests specified, the scheduler can make better decisions about which nodes to place pods on, and how to deal with resource contention.

Misconfigurations.Title: Memory requests not specified
Misconfigurations.Description: When containers have memory requests specified, the scheduler can make better decisions about which nodes to place pods on, and how to deal with resource contention.

Misconfigurations.Title: Memory not limited
Misconfigurations.Description: Enforcing memory limits prevents DoS via resource exhaustion.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs with UID <= 10000
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the container to run with user ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs with UID <= 10000
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the container to run with user ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs with GID <= 10000
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the container to run with group ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.

Misconfigurations.Title: Runs with GID <= 10000
Misconfigurations.Description: Force the container to run with group ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.

Misconfigurations.Title: All container images must start with the *.azurecr.io domain
Misconfigurations.Description: Containers should only use images from trusted registries.
Misconfigurations.Message: container init-permissions of statefulset redis in default namespace should restrict container image to your specific registry domain. For Azure any domain ending in 'azurecr.io'
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use images from trusted Azure registries.

Misconfigurations.Title: All container images must start with the *.azurecr.io domain
Misconfigurations.Description: Containers should only use images from trusted registries.
Misconfigurations.Message: container redis of statefulset redis in default namespace should restrict container image to your specific registry domain. For Azure any domain ending in 'azurecr.io'
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use images from trusted Azure registries.

Misconfigurations.Title: All container images must start with a GCR domain
Misconfigurations.Description: Containers should only use images from trusted GCR registries.
Misconfigurations.Message: container init-permissions of statefulset redis in default namespace should restrict container image to your specific registry domain. See the full GCR list here: https://cloud.google.com/container-registry/docs/overview#registries
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use images from trusted GCR registries.

Misconfigurations.Title: All container images must start with a GCR domain
Misconfigurations.Description: Containers should only use images from trusted GCR registries.
Misconfigurations.Message: container redis of statefulset redis in default namespace should restrict container image to your specific registry domain. See the full GCR list here: https://cloud.google.com/container-registry/docs/overview#registries
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Use images from trusted GCR registries.

Misconfigurations.Title: Container images from public registries used
Misconfigurations.Description: Container images must not start with an empty prefix or a defined public registry domain.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'redis' of StatefulSet 'redis' should restrict container image to use private registries

Misconfigurations.Title: All container images must start with an ECR domain
Misconfigurations.Description: Container images from non-ECR registries should be forbidden.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'init-permissions' of StatefulSet 'redis' should restrict images to own ECR repository. See the full ECR list here: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/ecr.html
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Container image should be used from Amazon container Registry

Misconfigurations.Title: All container images must start with an ECR domain
Misconfigurations.Description: Container images from non-ECR registries should be forbidden.
Misconfigurations.Message: Container 'redis' of StatefulSet 'redis' should restrict images to own ECR repository. See the full ECR list here: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/ecr.html
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Container image should be used from Amazon container Registry

Misconfigurations.Title: Containers must not set runAsUser to 0
Misconfigurations.Description: Containers should be forbidden from running with a root UID.
Misconfigurations.Message: securityContext.runAsUser should be set to a value greater than 0
Misconfigurations.Resolution: Set 'securityContext.runAsUser' to a non-zero integer or leave undefined.

Misconfigurations.Title: Workloads in the default namespace
Misconfigurations.Description: Checks whether a workload is running in the default namespace.
Misconfigurations.Message: statefulset redis in default namespace should set metadata.namespace to a non-default namespace
